<h2>Make Cross-Validation Partition Diagnostics</h2>

<h3>Description</h3>

<p>Calculates full-model and fold-training counts from location assignments and
aligned binary community responses for feasibility assessment.
</p>


<h3>Usage</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>make_cross_validation_partition_diagnostics(
  data_locations = NULL,
  data_assignments = NULL,
  data_community_matrix = NULL,
  cv_strategy = NULL,
  min_taxon_locations = 1L,
  min_taxon_samples = 1L,
  include_full_model = TRUE
)
</code></pre>


<h3>Arguments</h3>

<table role = "presentation">
<tr><td><code id="data_locations">data_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Location table returned by [make_cross_validation_location_table()].</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_assignments">data_assignments</code></td>
<td>
<p>Assignment table returned by a cross-validation assignment helper. May be
empty when 'cv_strategy = &quot;none&quot;' and only full-model diagnostics are
required.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="data_community_matrix">data_community_matrix</code></td>
<td>
<p>Numeric binary matrix with one row per original sample row and one column per
taxon. Row positions must match location 'row_indices'.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="cv_strategy">cv_strategy</code></td>
<td>
<p>Character scalar identifying the candidate strategy. Either
'&quot;spatially_stratified_group_kfold&quot;', '&quot;leave_one_location_out&quot;', or
'&quot;none&quot;' for full-model-only diagnostics.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="min_taxon_locations">min_taxon_locations</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer minimum number of training locations with a taxon presence.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="min_taxon_samples">min_taxon_samples</code></td>
<td>
<p>Positive integer minimum number of training samples with a taxon presence.</p>
</td></tr>
<tr><td><code id="include_full_model">include_full_model</code></td>
<td>
<p>Logical scalar. If 'TRUE', prepend the full-model diagnostic row. Defaults
to 'TRUE'.</p>
</td></tr>
</table>


<h3>Details</h3>

<p>Taxon viability is learned independently within each training partition. A
retained binary taxon must meet both occurrence thresholds and contain at
least one absence. MEM location counts equal the number of training
locations; additional mode-specific MEM checks can raise the threshold in
the feasibility assessor.
</p>


<h3>Value</h3>

<p>Tibble matching [assess_cross_validation_feasibility()] input, with one
optional full-model row and one row per repeat and fold.
</p>


<h3>Examples</h3>

<pre><code class='language-R'>data_locations &lt;-
  tibble::tibble(
    location_id = c("a", "b"),
    n_samples = c(1L, 1L),
    row_indices = list(1L, 2L)
  )
data_assignments &lt;-
  make_leave_one_location_out_assignments(data_locations)
make_cross_validation_partition_diagnostics(
  data_locations = data_locations,
  data_assignments = data_assignments,
  data_community_matrix = matrix(c(0, 1), ncol = 1L),
  cv_strategy = "leave_one_location_out"
)
</code></pre>

</main>
